title: Shifted dihedral isogeny quotients and the classification of exceptional rational functions of degree five
summary: We give a complete classification, up to $k$-Möbius equivalence, of exceptional rational functions of degree five over every finite field. The classification gives explicit normal forms in every characteristic, exact parameter identifications, and the resulting class counts. The main structural input is an arithmetic theory of shifted dihedral isogeny quotients valid in every odd degree.
